{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter out sentinel values
df_valid = df[(df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0) & (df['biomarker_final'] != -999.0)]

# Compute change in biomarker level
df_valid['change'] = df_valid['biomarker_final'] - df_valid['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean change by sex
mean_change_by_sex = df_valid.groupby('sex')['change'].mean()

# Confirm the values are positive
print(f"Mean change in biomarker level by sex:\n{mean_change_by_sex}")

# Compute the difference in mean change between females and males
difference = mean_change_by_sex['F'] - mean_change_by_sex['M']
print(f"\nDifference (F - M): {difference}")

# Show the actual change values to verify direction
print("\nSummary of change values:")
print(df_valid[['sex', 'biomarker_baseline', 'biomarker_final', 'change']].describe())"}
